response.sql: WITH gender_counts AS (SELECT c.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT i.order_id) AS invoiced_order_count FROM Invoices i JOIN Orders o ON i.order_id = o.order_id JOIN Customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.gender), gender_shares AS (SELECT gender, invoiced_order_count, CAST(invoiced_order_count AS DECIMAL(38,18)) / SUM(invoiced_order_count) OVER () AS share FROM gender_counts), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM gender_shares) SELECT gs.gender, gs.invoiced_order_count, gs.share, gs.share - a.avg_share AS above_average_share FROM gender_shares gs CROSS JOIN average_share a WHERE gs.share > a.avg_share
